title: OKR Compass and delivery scaffold for cross-functional initiatives
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Design and pilot an "OKR Compass" — a lightweight, repeatable scaffold that connects company-level OKRs to initiative-level delivery plans and clarifies roles, cadence, and success signals across Eng/Design/Product/GTMT/Support.

Why: Current company OKRs are well-defined but teams struggle to translate them into actionable initiative slices and measurable deliverables. We need a standard that reduces coordination overhead, surfaces dependency risk earlier, and accelerates rollouts with consistent guardrails.

Scope:
- Define the Compass artifact (one-page mapping + 3-week delivery scaffold + escalation lanes).
- Create templates (Confluence + Miro + Linear ticket archetypes) and an example filled for the next major initiative (runtime-1.20 perf uplift).
- Pilot with two cross-functional initiatives (runtime perf and console rollouts).
- Produce a short playbook for handoffs, weekly cadence, and OKR signal reviews.

Out-of-scope for initial pilot: org-wide mandate; tooling enforcement in Console (we'll surface later as a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: A reusable OKR Compass template exists in Confluence with fields: Objective, Key Results, Initiative owner, Delivery slices (3-week), Dependencies, Success indicators, Escalation path
Two pilot initiatives complete the Compass mapping and run the 3-week scaffold with documented weekly check-ins
A short playbook (<= 2 pages) is published and acknowledged by PM/EM leads of participating teams
A dashboard (BigQuery/Looker link) shows at least one measurable KR tracked end-to-end for each pilot
Feedback loop captured from pilots with at least 6 concrete improvements to the template or cadence

implementation_notes: Start with minimal required fields so teams can complete a Compass in ~1 hour. Emphasize: 1) owner, 2) one lead KR with concrete metric, 3) three short delivery slices, 4) top 3 dependencies, 5) escalation contact. Use the runtime perf initiative as canonical example and iterate based on pilot feedback.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams treat Compass as paperwork and skip the dependency step. Mitigation: require EM sign-off and include dependency review in the weekly Compass Check.
Risk: Metrics not instrumented or owned. Mitigation: include metric owner field and create instrumentation tickets during slice 0.
Risk: Slack in cross-team communication leads to missed handoffs. Mitigation: define a 30-minute weekly cross-team sync and enforce agenda; surface blocker dashboard to leadership if blocked >1 week.
